blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday received outgoing Spanish Ambassador to the Philippines Miguel Utray in a farewell call at Malacañan Palace. In a press release, the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said Marcos thanked Utray for his contributions to strengthening cooperation between the Philippines and Spain during his four-year tour of duty
